blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Wednesday called for greater transparency in the government’s proposed Pax Silica initiative, questioning the changing details for the project. Sens. Bam Aquino and Imee Marcos raised the concern while the proposed 2027 budget of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) was being tackled in the Senate plenary. BCDA, a government-owned and controlled corporation tasked with developing former military reservations and other government properties, is overseeing the proposed Pax Silica industrial hub in New Clark City in Tarlac. “Ang kailangan din po natin ng transparency dito, ‘no?
